# r3v3rs3

> A reverse proxy server with a built-in WebUI for TCP, UDP, TLS, HTTP, WebSocket and HTTP/3, and a deployment platform that runs your apps behind it, written in Rust. It is a fork of Taxy.

r3v3rs3 runs as a single binary. You configure it in a browser, not in a configuration file: every port, proxy, certificate and account is a form in the WebUI, and the same operations are available over an admin API. It can also build its proxies from Docker labels or etcd keys.

The deployment platform runs apps as containers on the Docker Engine of the server or of a remote server with the r3v3rs3 agent. An app comes from a registry image, from a Git repository with its Dockerfile, or from the Docker Compose file of a Git repository. A deployment is blue-green, and r3v3rs3 routes the domains of the apps itself. Git provider connections (a GitHub App, or an OAuth app for GitLab and Gitea) list the repositories, clone private ones and install the push webhook that starts a deployment.

The documentation is published in English at the root and in Turkish under `/tr/`. Every page listed below has a Turkish translation at the same path with the `/tr/` prefix.

## Documentation

- [Full documentation](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/llms-full.txt): every page with an extended description of its content
- [Overview](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/): what r3v3rs3 does and the feature list
- [Configuration and Storage](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/reference/storage/): the config directory, backups and disaster recovery
- [Ports](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/reference/ports/): every port field, with its default
- [Proxies](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/reference/proxies/): every proxy field, with its default
- [Certificates and ACME](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/reference/certificates/): certificates, ACME, DNS credentials and CT monitoring
- [Service Discovery](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/reference/discovery/): Docker and etcd sources
- [Deployment Platform](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/reference/platform/): image, Git and Compose apps, deployments and rollback, webhooks, Git providers and agent targets
- [Accounts](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/reference/accounts/): the roles, the permissions and the proxy list of a panel account
- [Host Firewall](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/reference/firewall/): the nftables table of the host
- [Server Operation](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/reference/server/): workers, upgrades, HTTP limits, stream priority and metrics
- [MCP and CLI](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/reference/mcp-and-cli/): the MCP server, its tools and the r3 client
- [Administration](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/reference/administration/): settings, the WebUI, the admin API, the audit log and logging
- [Release Verification](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/reference/release-verification/): checking the signature of a release
- [Development](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/reference/development/): build the server and the WebUI from source

## Tutorials

- [Installing on a Linux Server](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/install-linux/): install as a systemd service with install.sh
- [Getting Started](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/getting-started/): from the first account to the first working proxy
- [Proxies from Docker](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/docker-discovery/): let containers define their own proxies with labels
- [HTTPS with a Wildcard Certificate](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/https-certificates/): DNS-01, renewal and HTTP/3
- [Protecting an Application](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/protect-an-app/): IP filter, authentication, rate limit and audit log
- [Caching and Compression](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/cache-and-compression/): answer repeated requests from memory and send smaller responses
- [TCP and UDP Proxies](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/tcp-and-udp/): publish a database over TCP and a DNS server over UDP, with mutual TLS
- [Load Balancing and Health Checks](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/load-balancing/): weights, health checks, sticky sessions, WebSocket and gRPC
- [Driving r3v3rs3 from a Script](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/admin-api/): sign in to the admin API and drive it from CI
- [MCP and the Command Line Client](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/mcp-and-cli/): turn on MCP, connect an AI client, install r3 and sign in
- [Proxies from etcd](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/etcd-discovery/): let etcd keys define their own proxies
- [Accounts for a Team](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/team-accounts/): per-person proxies, TOTP and the audit log
- [Single Sign-On with Forward Auth](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/forward-auth/): oauth2-proxy in front of an application
- [Migrating from nginx or Traefik](https://r3v3rs3.keremgok.tr/tutorials/migrate/): translate the configuration and cut over
